text:
Iona Keller: Hey all 44b Iona here, starting today as Product Ops. Small setup + intro thread. Im East Coast and planning to visit the SF office in two weeks. Two asks: can someone add me to the product-playbooks repo? Also debating whether to request a loaner M2 for occasional local testing or use my personal laptop for now. Two truths & a lie: I once got lost in Tokyo for 6 hours, I can play the violin, I have a pet axolotl. Which is the lie?

Nora Kim: Welcome Iona!! :tada: Adding you to #product. For laptop: if youll occasionally run small tests, personal is fine for the first week; request a loaner via IT if you need heavier profiling. Post your GitHub handle and Ill ping repo owners.

IT Support: Hi Iona 44b Please submit hardware + access at https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you paste your GitHub handle we can pre-stage invites and create a yubikey/VPN ticket. If you hit a git auth error, include the command output.

Iona Keller: GitHub handle is ionak. Quick clone attempt produced: ```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/product-playbooks.git
Cloning into 'product-playbooks'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```
Any quick local checks I can run while IT processes the form?

Maya Chen: swag note: if youre in SF, swing by and grab a Welcome Pack C. Also we do a light "two truths" at lunch  bring the axolotl photo if its real. :smile:

Nora Kim: Try `ssh -T git@github.com` to see if your key is picked up. If not, generate one: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "iona@redwood.ai"` then add the pubkey to GitHub. If you want, I can screenshare for 10m.

DevEx Bot: Note: Iona Keller added to #product and #new-hires. Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist created: hardware pending, repo access pending.

Iona Keller: Thanks everyone 60a I filed the IT request and pasted my SSH pub key in the ticket. Looking forward to meeting folks in SF and debating whether the violin or axolotl is the fib 3b6
